description: This is a test source file for the DirectBootAwareSharedPreferences class, containing unit tests that verify its behavior in different device states and configurations, including handling of direct boot mode, receiver registration, and preference change notifications.

classes.name: DirectBootAwareSharedPreferencesTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the DirectBootAwareSharedPreferences class, verifying behavior in different device states, SDK versions, and preference change scenarios.

classes.name: TestSharedPreferencesFactory
classes.description: A mock implementation of SharedPreferencesFactory used in tests to simulate direct boot mode and user unlock states.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test.

methods.name: testInNormalModeRedirects
methods.description: Verifies that preferences are correctly stored and retrieved in normal mode.

methods.name: testInLockedModeDoesNothing
methods.description: Verifies that preference modifications do not occur when in direct boot (locked) mode.

methods.name: testInLockedToNormalModeSwitch
methods.description: Tests switching from locked to normal mode and the persistence of preferences.

methods.name: testDoesNotCreateReceiverIfOldVersion
methods.description: Ensures no receiver is registered on SDK versions below M.

methods.name: testDoesNotCreateReceiverIfNoNeed
methods.description: Ensures no receiver is registered when direct boot is not needed.

methods.name: testCreateReceiverIfNeededAndRemovesWhenInTheClear
methods.description: Verifies receiver registration and unregistration based on direct boot state changes.

methods.name: testCallsOnReadyAfterCreateOnOldDevices
methods.description: Checks that the callback is invoked immediately on older devices.

methods.name: testCallsOnReadyIfDeviceIsUnlocked
methods.description: Verifies callback invocation when device is already unlocked.

methods.name: testCallsOnReadyAfterDeviceIsUnlocked
methods.description: Verifies callback invocation after device unlock.

methods.name: testListenersPassedWhenSwitchPrefImpl
methods.description: Tests that preference change listeners are correctly passed and invoked.

methods.name: testListenersCalledWithAllKeysWhenSwitched
methods.description: Verifies that listeners are called with the correct key values after switching modes.

methods.name: testListenersNotPassedWhenSwitchPrefImplIfRemoved
methods.description: Ensures that unregistered listeners are not called.
